trips.name: Sintra
trips.description: A fairy-tale hill town reached by a 40-minute direct train from Rossio, home to the colourful Pena Palace, the Moorish Castle and the Quinta da Regaleira gardens.

trips.name: Cascais
trips.description: A seaside resort town on the Cascais line from Cais do Sodré (about 40 minutes each way), with beaches, a pleasant old town, a marina and the dramatic Boca do Inferno cliffs nearby.

trips.name: Óbidos
trips.description: A beautifully preserved walled medieval town about 1 hour from Lisbon by direct bus from Campo Grande, known for its whitewashed lanes, castle walls and ginjinha cherry liqueur served in chocolate cups.
